contentBoundary: Topic copy is data. Rule evaluation remains executable behavior in crates/msc-domain/src/router/troubleshooting.rs and fallback_tree.rs.

topics.title: Your host's local IP changed
topics.summary: The router may still forward to an old device address.

topics.title: You may be behind two routers
topics.summary: Forwarding on the wrong router does not expose the server.

topics.title: Your ISP may be using CGNAT
topics.summary: Some internet plans do not provide a public IPv4 address to forward through.

topics.title: You configured the wrong device
topics.summary: The provider name is not always the device doing routing.

topics.title: The port forward may point to the wrong target device
topics.summary: The rule must target the computer hosting MSC.

topics.title: A firewall may be blocking the port
topics.summary: A correct router rule still needs the host firewall to permit the server port.

topics.title: The forwarding protocol may be wrong
topics.summary: The router rule must use the protocol the selected server requires.

topics.title: Your router may need to apply the change
topics.summary: Some routers do not activate a new rule until settings are saved or the router restarts.

topics.title: You may not have router admin access
topics.summary: A landlord, parent, ISP, or administrator may control the router settings.
